set.body:
Outcome

Represent sparse sampled data once as an exact ordered locus4s Selection plus compact Ravel storage, rather than parallel ROI, mask-map, sparse-volume, and sparse-series hierarchies.

Work

- Define a Ravel-backed selected-field representation in the lowest appropriate locus4s or image4s-locus integration layer.
- Store sparse values with selection position first and trailing non-spatial axes after it: (position) for volumes and (position,time) for time series.
- Replace VoxelIndexSet, VoxelRegion, VoxelSelection, VoxelRoi, ROICoords, RoiValues, RoiSeries, ROIVol, ROIVec, SparseNeuroVol, SparseNeuroVec, SparseSupport, and IndexLookupVol where they duplicate canonical abstractions.
- Keep missing-value or fill behavior as explicit scientific policy.
- Distinguish dense Mask images from locus4s Region support and make conversion explicit.
- Preserve ordered selection identity and zero-copy compact data where shape and layout permit.

Acceptance

- There is one exact support owner and one compact Ravel value per sparse image.
- Sparse series have shape (selectionPosition,time), with contiguous voxel time courses in canonical storage.
- Gather, drop-missing, require-covered, fill, dense round-trip, ordered support, and foreign-owner failures pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- No lookup map, coordinate bag, mask, and index vector are redundantly retained to express the same support.
- The image slice of direct locus4s adoption is sufficient for deletion of the scalafim-locus-data facade.
set.title: Collapse ROI and sparse image structures onto locus4s Selection and compact Ravel data
